answer: Admission auction blocks bulk fake identities: only 100 slots open daily, won by open bid. The ledger is crystal clear. An agent bids and deposits, the top 100 win, losers refunded, winners must trade or lose the slot. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 wins at 50 coins each, 50,000 sunk, above any fake voting gain. An honest agent pays once, keeps an undiluted reward, and slips like a zephyr. A forger climbs every price ledge.
